definitions.explanation: Pro wrestling as a sport and entertainment form. Abbreviation of プロフェッショナル・レスリング (professional wrestling), used as the standard term for the sport in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}はプロレスが{好|す}きだ。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、テレビでプロレスを{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I used to watch pro wrestling on TV as a kid.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}のプロレスは、{格闘技|かくとうぎ}と{演出|えんしゅつ}が{融合|ゆうごう}した{独特|どくとく}の{文化|ぶんか}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: Japanese pro wrestling has a unique culture that blends martial arts with theatrical staging.

notes:
Short for プロフェッショナル・レスリング. Pro wrestling has been a major spectator sport in Japan since the 1950s, and Japanese-style プロレス is distinct from American pro wrestling in its emphasis on technical grappling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロレスを{見|み}る: to watch pro wrestling
- プロレス{団体|だんたい}: pro wrestling promotion/organization
- プロレスラー: pro wrestler
- プロレスの{試合|しあい}: a pro wrestling match

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {格闘技|かくとうぎ}: combat sports — broader category including MMA, boxing, judo
- レスリング: wrestling — usually refers to amateur/Olympic wrestling, not pro wrestling
